```{r, load-data}
# load image and table
load("processed_data/aggregating.rda")
aggregated_dt <- fread("processed_data/aggregated_dt_filtered.csv.gz", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
source("05zz-feature-preprocessing.R")
# remove manual_ids, i.e., filter IDs in keep_rows
# aggregated_dt <- aggregated_dt[ID %in% keep_rows]
# check if there are still manual_ids in the dt
# stopifnot(!any(manual_ids %in% aggregated_dt$ID))
aggregated_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = to_analyze)]

# set some global_variables
meta_exclude_cols <- c(
  "ID", "PSI", "IHEC", "Event Type", "gene_id", "Variability", "annotation", "uuid", "transcript_filter",
  "seqnames", "ontology", "project", "protocol"
)
sdcols <- names(aggregated_dt)[!names(aggregated_dt) %in% meta_exclude_cols]
aggregation_columns <- c("Event Type", "transcript_filter", "uuid", "Variability")
non_epigenetic_features <- c("gene_expression", "distance_TSS", "distance_gene_start", "distance_TES", "distance_gene_end", "width;upstream_other_region", "width;event_name", "width;downstream_other_region", "3ss", "3ssdown", "5ss", "5ssup")
main_cor <- "spearman"
main_variability <- "All"
main_partial <- TRUE
main_protocol <- "All"
main_preprocessing <- "Preprocessed"
preprocessing_colors <- c(
  "Raw" = "grey55",
  "Preprocessed" = "#1b9e77"
)
```

```{r, generate-cor-dt}
corr_file_raw <- "processed_data/correlation_intrinsic.csv.gz"
corr_file_preproc <- "processed_data/correlation_intrinsic_preproc.csv.gz"

full_cor <- function(y, PSI, cor_method, this_minimum_events = minimum_events) {
  rmv <- is.na(y) | is.na(PSI)
  res <- NA_real_
  if ((length(rmv) - sum(rmv)) >= this_minimum_events) {
    res <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(PSI, y, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = cor_method))
  }
  as.numeric(res)
}

partial_cor <- function(y_name, y, rest_dt, cor_method, this_minimum_events = minimum_events) {
  this_rest_dt <- copy(rest_dt)
  if (y_name %in% names(this_rest_dt)) {
    this_rest_dt <- this_rest_dt[, !..y_name]
  }

  this_rest_dt <- na.omit(this_rest_dt[, test_column := y])
  this_non_epigenetic_features <- intersect(non_epigenetic_features, names(this_rest_dt))
  corr <- NA_real_

  if (
    this_rest_dt[, .N] >= this_minimum_events &&
      stats::sd(this_rest_dt[, test_column]) != 0 &&
      stats::sd(this_rest_dt[, PSI]) != 0
  ) {
    if (length(this_non_epigenetic_features) > 0L) {
      rhs <- paste0("`", this_non_epigenetic_features, "`", collapse = " + ")
      psi_res <- resid(stats::lm(stats::as.formula(paste("PSI ~", rhs)), data = this_rest_dt))
      test_res <- resid(stats::lm(stats::as.formula(paste("test_column ~", rhs)), data = this_rest_dt))
      cor_result <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(test_res, psi_res, method = cor_method))
    } else {
      cor_result <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(this_rest_dt$test_column, this_rest_dt$PSI, method = cor_method))
    }
    corr <- unname(cor_result$estimate)
  }

  as.numeric(corr)
}

prepare_with_all_variability <- function(input_dt) {
  prepared_dt <- copy(input_dt)
  prepared_dt[metadata, on = c(IHEC = "epirr_id_without_version"), annotation := harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1]
  rbind(
    prepared_dt,
    copy(prepared_dt)[, Variability := "All"]
  )
}

append_protocol_levels <- function(input_cor_dt) {
  output_dt <- copy(input_cor_dt)
  output_dt[file_metadata, on = .(uuid), protocol := experiment_type]
  output_dt <- rbind(output_dt, copy(output_dt)[, protocol := "All"])
  output_dt[, protocol := factor(protocol)]
  output_dt
}

compute_all_cor <- function(input_dt, apply_preprocessing = FALSE) {
  prepared_dt <- prepare_with_all_variability(input_dt)

  bind_group_results <- function(results, stage_label) {
    is_bindable <- vapply(
      results,
      function(x) data.table::is.data.table(x) || is.data.frame(x) || is.list(x),
      logical(1)
    )
    if (!all(is_bindable)) {
      first_bad <- which(!is_bindable)[1]
      stop(
        sprintf(
          "%s failed in group index %d. First worker output: %s",
          stage_label,
          first_bad,
          paste(capture.output(str(results[[first_bad]])), collapse = " ")
        )
      )
    }
    data.table::rbindlist(results)
  }

  transform_group <- function(group_dt) {
    if (!apply_preprocessing) {
      return(group_dt)
    }

    preprocess_data_table_features(
      dt = group_dt,
      feature_cols = sdcols,
      histone_marks = histone_marks,
      mode = "correlation",
      max_na_frac = 1,
      drop_sparse = FALSE
    )$dt
  }

  cor_dt <- rbindlist(
    lapply(setNames(cor_methods, cor_methods), function(cor_method) {
      groups_list <- split(prepared_dt, by = aggregation_columns)

      group_results <- pbmclapply(groups_list, function(group_dt) {
          proc_group_dt <- transform_group(group_dt)
          proc_group_dt[, lapply(.SD, full_cor, PSI, cor_method), by = aggregation_columns, .SDcols = sdcols]
        })
      bind_group_results(group_results, sprintf("full correlation (%s)", cor_method))
    }),
    idcol = "Correlation Coefficient"
  )
  cor_dt[, `Correlation Coefficient` := as.factor(`Correlation Coefficient`)]
  cor_dt[, `Partial Correlation` := FALSE]

  pcor_dt <- rbindlist(
    lapply(setNames(cor_methods, cor_methods), function(cor_method) {
      groups_list <- split(prepared_dt, by = aggregation_columns)

      group_results <- pbmclapply(groups_list, function(group_dt) {
          proc_group_dt <- transform_group(group_dt)
          rest_cols <- intersect(c("PSI", non_epigenetic_features), names(proc_group_dt))
          rest_dt <- proc_group_dt[, ..rest_cols]
          proc_group_dt[, mapply(
            y_name = sdcols,
            y = .SD,
            FUN = partial_cor,
            MoreArgs = list(
              rest_dt = rest_dt,
              cor_method = cor_method
            ),
            SIMPLIFY = FALSE
          ),
          by = aggregation_columns, .SDcols = sdcols
          ]
        })
      bind_group_results(group_results, sprintf("partial correlation (%s)", cor_method))
    }),
    idcol = "Correlation Coefficient"
  )
  pcor_dt[, `Correlation Coefficient` := as.factor(`Correlation Coefficient`)]
  pcor_dt[, `Partial Correlation` := TRUE]

  all_cor_dt <- rbind(cor_dt, pcor_dt)
  all_cor_dt[, Variability := factor(Variability, levels = c("Low", "All", "High"))]
  append_protocol_levels(all_cor_dt)
}

if (file.exists(corr_file_raw)) {
  all_cor_raw <- fread(corr_file_raw, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
} else {
  all_cor_raw <- compute_all_cor(aggregated_dt, apply_preprocessing = FALSE)
  fwrite(all_cor_raw, corr_file_raw)
}

if (file.exists(corr_file_preproc)) {
  all_cor_preproc <- fread(corr_file_preproc, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
} else {
  all_cor_preproc <- compute_all_cor(aggregated_dt, apply_preprocessing = TRUE)
  fwrite(all_cor_preproc, corr_file_preproc)
}

all_cor_raw[, Preprocessing := "Raw"]
all_cor_preproc[, Preprocessing := "Preprocessed"]
all_cor <- rbind(all_cor_raw, all_cor_preproc, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
all_cor[, Preprocessing := factor(Preprocessing, levels = c("Raw", "Preprocessed"))]
```

```{r, nicer-names}
# this chunk just changes some names in the dt so the plots look nicer
melt_cor_dt <- melt(all_cor, id.vars = c("Event Type", "transcript_filter", "uuid", "Variability", "Partial Correlation", "Correlation Coefficient", "protocol", "Preprocessing"), variable.name = "feature", value.name = "Correlation w/ PSI")
melt_cor_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = c("SE", "RI"))]
melt_cor_dt[`Event Type` == "SE", feature := gsub("other_region", "Intron", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[`Event Type` == "RI", feature := gsub("other_region", "Exon", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[`Event Type` == "SE", feature := gsub("event_name", "SE", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[`Event Type` == "RI", feature := gsub("event_name", "RI", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub(";", "\n", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub(",", "\n", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := gsub("_", " ", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("distance ", "Distance\n", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("upstream Intron", "Intron\nUpstream", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("upstream Exon", "Exon\nUpstream", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("downstream Intron", "Intron\nDownstream", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("downstream Exon", "Exon\nDownstream", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("gene expression", "Gene\nExpression", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("width", "Width", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
aggregate_median_by <- c("feature", "Event Type", "transcript_filter", "Variability", "Partial Correlation", "Correlation Coefficient", "protocol", "Preprocessing")
melt_cor_dt[, median_cor := median(`Correlation w/ PSI`, na.rm = TRUE), by = aggregate_median_by]
melt_cor_dt[, mean_cor := mean(`Correlation w/ PSI`, na.rm = TRUE), by = aggregate_median_by]
melt_cor_dt[, sd_cor := sd(`Correlation w/ PSI`, na.rm = TRUE), by = aggregate_median_by]
melt_cor_dt[, relevant := any(abs(median_cor) > .1), by = aggregate_median_by]
melt_cor_dt[, Variability := sub(" Variability", "", Variability, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, Variability := factor(Variability, levels = c("Low", "All", "High"))]
melt_cor_dt[, protocol := factor(protocol)]
melt_cor_dt[, Preprocessing := factor(Preprocessing, levels = c("Raw", "Preprocessed"))]
```

```{r, top10-overall, fig.width=21, fig.height=8}
library(ggh4x)
library(tidytext)
top_n <- 10 # melt_cor_dt[, uniqueN(feature)]
# get the top n correlations with PSI from the feature vector
tmp_cor_dt <- melt_cor_dt[`Variability` == main_variability & `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor & `Partial Correlation` == main_partial & protocol == main_protocol & Preprocessing == main_preprocessing]
tmp_cor_dt[order(-abs(median_cor)), .(feature = unique(feature)[1:top_n]), by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)]
# annotate epigenetic vs intrinsic features
tmp_cor_dt[, "Feature Type" := ifelse(Reduce(`|`, lapply(c(histone_marks, "DNAm"), function(x) startsWith(feature, x))), "Epigenetic", "Intrinsic")]
tmp_cor_dt[feature %in% c("max promoter", "summed enhancer"), `Feature Type` := "Epigenetic"]
plot_dt <- merge(tmp_cor_dt, tmp_cor_dt[order(-abs(median_cor)), .(feature = unique(feature)[1:top_n]), by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)])
# Create a vector of colors for ggplot, defaulting to dark grey
plot_colors <- setNames(rep("dark grey", plot_dt[, uniqueN(feature)]), plot_dt[, unique(feature)])
for (name in names(mark_hex_colors)) {
  inds <- startsWith(names(plot_colors), name)
  plot_colors[inds] <- mark_hex_colors[name]
}
# plot
ggplot(
  plot_dt,
  aes(
    y = `Correlation w/ PSI`,
    x = tidytext::reorder_within(feature, -median_cor, list(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)),
    color = feature
  )
) + # `Feature Type`)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "light grey", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = NULL, #' Aggregated Signal or Statistic',
    title = NULL # , paste('Top', top_n, 'Globally Correlated Features')
  ) +
  tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(. ~ `Event Type` + factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters),
    nrow = 2,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = plot_colors) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("top", top_n, "intrinsic_overall.png")), width = 21, height = 6)
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("top", top_n, "intrinsic_overall.svg")), width = 21, height = 6)
```


```{r, comparison-plots, fig.width=21, fig.height=8}
# make plots comparing different measures and variability
for (color_by in c("Correlation Coefficient", "Partial Correlation", "Variability", "protocol", "Preprocessing")) {
  # aggregate the medians by the relevant columns
  find_relevant_by <- aggregate_median_by[aggregate_median_by != color_by]
  # remove column from earlier iteration
  melt_cor_dt[, plot_relevant := NULL]
  # set which columns are relevant
  melt_cor_dt[, plot_relevant := any(relevant), by = mget(find_relevant_by)]
  # get the subset of the table that is relevant depending on what to compare
  not_color_by <- TRUE
  if (color_by == "Partial Correlation") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[, `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor & `Variability` == main_variability & protocol == main_protocol & Preprocessing == main_preprocessing]
  } else if (color_by == "Correlation Coefficient") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[, `Partial Correlation` == main_partial & `Variability` == main_variability & protocol == main_protocol & Preprocessing == main_preprocessing]
  } else if (color_by == "Variability") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[, `Partial Correlation` == main_partial & `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor & protocol == main_protocol & Preprocessing == main_preprocessing]
  } else if (color_by == "protocol") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[, `Partial Correlation` == main_partial & `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor & `Variability` == main_variability & Preprocessing == main_preprocessing]
  } else if (color_by == "Preprocessing") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[, `Partial Correlation` == main_partial & `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor & `Variability` == main_variability & protocol == main_protocol]
  }
  # get the number of levels we need to color_by
  color_levels <- melt_cor_dt[not_color_by, uniqueN(get(color_by))]
  tmp_cor_dt <- melt_cor_dt[not_color_by & !is.na(`Correlation w/ PSI`), if (uniqueN(get(color_by)) == color_levels) .SD, by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, feature)]
  if (color_by == "Variability") {
    # for variablity make another plot sorted by the greatest differences
    median_dt <- dcast(tmp_cor_dt[, .(median_cor = unique(median_cor)), by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, feature, `Variability`)], `Event Type` + transcript_filter + feature ~ `Variability`, value.var = "median_cor")
    median_dt[, diff_col := abs(`Low` - `High`)]
    sorted_idx <- median_dt[, order(-diff_col)]
    p <- ggplot(
      merge(tmp_cor_dt, median_dt[sorted_idx, .(feature = feature[1:top_n], diff_col = diff_col[1:top_n], all_median = All[1:top_n]), by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)]),
      aes(
        y = `Correlation w/ PSI`,
        x = tidytext::reorder_within(feature, -diff_col, list(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)),
        fill = get(color_by)
      )
    ) +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(x = "Aggregated Signal or Statistic") +
      tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
      ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(. ~ `Event Type` + factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters), scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = variability_colors[1:color_levels], name = color_by)
    ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("max diff ", color_by, "_intrinsic.pdf")), p, width = 21, height = 7)
    print(p)
  }
  # always make one plot sorted by the median
  p <- ggplot(
    merge(tmp_cor_dt, tmp_cor_dt[order(-abs(median_cor)), .(feature = unique(feature)[1:top_n]), by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)]),
    aes(
      y = `Correlation w/ PSI`,
      x = tidytext::reorder_within(feature, -median_cor, list(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)),
      color = get(color_by)
    )
  ) +
    theme_bw() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(x = "Aggregated Signal or Statistic") +
    tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
    ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(. ~ `Event Type` + factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters), scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))
  if (color_by == "Preprocessing") {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = preprocessing_colors, name = color_by)
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = variability_colors, name = color_by)
  }
  if (color_levels == 2) {
    if (color_by == "Preprocessing") {
      p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = preprocessing_colors, name = color_by)
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = unname(variability_colors[c(1, 3)]), name = color_by)
    }
  } else if (color_by == "protocol") {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = setNames(variability_colors, c("total-RNA-Seq", "All", "mRNA-Seq")), name = color_by)
  }
  if (color_by == "Variability") {
    ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("top", top_n, color_by, "_intrinsic.pdf")), p, width = 21, height = 4.5)
  } else if (color_by == "Preprocessing") {
    ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("top", top_n, "_preprocessing_intrinsic.pdf")), p, width = 21, height = 4.5)
  }
  print(p)
}
```

```{r, top10-preprocessing-comparison, fig.width=21, fig.height=8}
# explicit preprocessing vs no-preprocessing comparison on top features
preproc_cmp_dt <- melt_cor_dt[
  `Variability` == main_variability &
    `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor &
    `Partial Correlation` == main_partial &
    protocol == main_protocol
]

preproc_rank_dt <- preproc_cmp_dt[
  , .(median_cor = unique(median_cor)),
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, feature, Preprocessing)
]

preproc_diff_dt <- dcast(
  preproc_rank_dt,
  `Event Type` + transcript_filter + feature ~ Preprocessing,
  value.var = "median_cor"
)
preproc_diff_dt[, diff_preproc := abs(Preprocessed - Raw)]

preproc_top_dt <- merge(
  preproc_cmp_dt,
  preproc_diff_dt[order(-diff_preproc), .(feature = feature[1:top_n]), by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)]
)

p_preproc <- ggplot(
  preproc_top_dt,
  aes(
    y = `Correlation w/ PSI`,
    x = tidytext::reorder_within(feature, -median_cor, list(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)),
    color = Preprocessing
  )
) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Aggregated Signal or Statistic") +
  tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(. ~ `Event Type` + factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters), scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = preprocessing_colors)

ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("top", top_n, "_preprocessing_explicit_intrinsic.pdf")), p_preproc, width = 21, height = 4.5)
print(p_preproc)
```

```{r, cor-heatmap, fig.width=21, fig.height=8}
# make heatmap with the correlation per feature
heatmap_dt <- unique(melt_cor_dt[
  `Partial Correlation` == main_partial & `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor & `Variability` == main_variability & protocol == main_protocol & Preprocessing == main_preprocessing & grepl(paste(c(histone_marks, "DNAm"), collapse = "|"), x = feature),
  .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, feature, protocol, median_cor, mean_cor, sd_cor)
])
heatmap_dt[, mark := tstrsplit(x = feature, split = "\n", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)]
heatmap_dt[, mark := factor(mark, levels = rev(c("H3K9me3", "H3K27me3", "H3K4me3", "H3K4me1", "H3K27ac", "H3K36me3", "DNAm")))]
heatmap_dt[, region := sub(pattern = ".*?\n", replacement = "", x = feature)]
heatmap_dt[, region := factor(region, levels = c("5up", "5down", "3up", "3down"))] # c("Intron\nUpstream", "SE", "Intron\nDownstream", "Exon\nUpstream", "RI", "Exon\nDownstream")),]
ggplot(heatmap_dt, aes(
  x = region,
  y = mark,
  fill = median_cor
)) +
  geom_tile() +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters) ~ `Event Type` + protocol, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = scales::muted("blue"),
    mid = "white",
    high = scales::muted("red")
  ) +
  # add text into the tile with the value of the mean and sd_cor in parantheses
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(median_cor, 2), "\n(", round(mean_cor, 2), "\u00B1", round(sd_cor, 2), ")")), size = 3) +
  labs(y = "Mark", x = "Region", fill = "Partial Correlation")
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "epigenetic_cor_intrinsic.pdf"), width = 21, height = 8)
```
